system.description: This spherical, blood-red hearthstone is unusual in that using it involves giving it away. When the owner makes a bargain, treaty or other agreement with another person, he can give that person the oathstone as a token of the deal. The stone enforces the bargain exactly like the Eclipse Caste anima power, except that neither party needs to pay any Essence to seal the oath. If either party breaks the agreement, he horribly botches one of her next vitally important rolls. In addition, both parties instantly know that the agreement has been broken. If the agreement is broken, mutually dissolved or simply concludes naturally, the stone instantly reappears in its rightful owner's possession. Also, even after giving the stone away, the giver regains Essence from it as if she still carried it.
